e2e_flows.name: Hook DLL File Access -> Agent ABAC -> Decision
steps: Hook DLL intercepts NtCreateFile/NtWriteFile via trampolines
Sends HookRequest over named pipe to dlp-agent
Agent handle_connection() deserializes HookRequest
handle_hook_request() performs full ABAC evaluation via inner_handler
Returns HookResponse with decision, cache_hint, cache_version
Hook DLL applies decision (Allow/Deny)

e2e_flows.name: Agent Heartbeat -> Server -> Policy Sync
steps: Agent heartbeat loop sends EndpointIdentity with health_status
Server receives heartbeat, updates agent registry
Server returns policy updates, approval tokens, tamper flags
Agent applies policy changes, updates approval cache
Agent calls report_tamper_detected() if tamper_detected_for_agent matches

e2e_flows.name: ETW Kernel-File -> Bypass Correlator -> Server -> SIEM
steps: ETW consumer receives Kernel-File events
BypassCorrelator matches events against hook journal entries
Correlator produces BypassAlert on mismatch
Agent server_client.post_bypass() sends batch to server
Server bypass_batch_ingest_handler stores alerts in SQLite
SIEM relay forwards alerts to external SIEM
e2e_flows.breaks_at: Hook DLL generated bypass alerts are NEVER received by agent because IpcPayloadV1 lacks BypassAlert variant

e2e_flows.name: Volume Class Resolution -> ABAC Policy Evaluation
steps: Hook DLL determines source/destination volume class via Windows API
classify_path_with_volume_class() called with volume class params
e2e_flows.breaks_at: Volume class parameters are discarded; HookRequest has no volume class fields; ABAC never sees volume class
missing_steps: Agent reads volume class from request
ABAC PolicyCondition::DeviceHealth evaluates with volume class context

e2e_flows.name: Fail-Mode ISOLATED -> RESYNC -> HEALTHY
steps: Agent detects cache miss or version mismatch -> ISOLATED
Hook DLL uses shared-memory cache for fail-closed decisions
Background thread polls cache_version every 100ms
e2e_flows.breaks_at: Automatic ISOLATED->RESYNC transition depends on background thread detecting new cache_version from agent. Thread is implemented but runtime behavior not verified.
missing_steps: Verified automatic transition from ISOLATED to RESYNC to HEALTHY

e2e_flows.name: Admin TUI -> Protected Paths / Bypass Alerts / Audit Integrity
steps: MainMenu -> SystemMenu (index 2)
SystemMenu has 15 items including Protected Paths (10), Bypass Alerts (11), Audit Integrity (14)
Enter key dispatches to action_load_protected_path_list, action_load_bypass_alert_list, action_load_audit_integrity
Screens fetch data from server API
Render functions display data with pagination, filters, detail popups
e2e_flows.note: Milestone audit incorrectly flagged this as broken. Fully verified.

e2e_flows.name: Approval Workflow -> Agent Enforcement
steps: Admin TUI creates approval token with Ed25519 signature
Server stores approval in database
Agent fetches active approvals via GET /agent/approvals/active
ApprovalCache stores and verifies JWT tokens
e2e_flows.breaks_at: Hook IPC path (file access decisions) does NOT check ApprovalCache. TODO(WORKFLOW-04-followup) is still open.
missing_steps: HookRequest includes PID or user_sid for cache key construction
handle_hook_request() checks approval cache on DENY decisions

e2e_flows.name: Audit Event Ingest -> Hash Chain Verification -> Tamper Detection -> Health + SIEM + Syslog
steps: Agent sends audit events to server POST /audit/events
Server verifies SHA-256 hash chain continuity
On chain break: creates ChainBreakDetected synthetic event
Sends tamper_detected_for_agent in IngestEventsResponse
Agent receives response, calls report_tamper_detected()
DeviceHealthStatus transitions to Tampered
ChainBreakDetected events routed to SIEM relay
ChainBreakDetected events queued to syslog_queue
Admin TUI Audit Integrity screen displays chain breaks
e2e_flows.note: v0.11.0 Phase 68.1 fully wired this flow. Verified end-to-end.

e2e_flows.name: Monitor-Only / Audit-Only Mode -> Bypass Alert Gating
steps: Admin sets global_enforcement_mode or per-policy mode
Agent receives mode in heartbeat/policy sync
e2e_flows.breaks_at: BypassCorrelator does not check enforcement mode. No code path from mode setting to correlator behavior change.
missing_steps: In Audit mode: log bypass but do not trigger_alert

e2e_flows.name: Label Assignment -> Folder Inheritance -> File Classification
steps: Admin assigns label to folder via TUI
Server LabelService resolves label to tier with inheritance
Label stored in database with path pattern
e2e_flows.breaks_at: Agent does not query LabelService for file classification. Hook DLL uses direct path ABAC evaluation without label awareness.
missing_steps: Agent queries server for label-based tier resolution
Hook DLL or agent uses label-derived tier in classification
